## What's Changed
* fix(deps): resolve critical/high Dependabot alerts (proxy-addr, shell-quote, source-map-js) by @tonychang04 in https://github.com/InsForge/InsForge/pull/2136
* chore(yun-tianming): drop dead types, trim narration, fix doc drift by @Fermionic-Lyu in https://github.com/InsForge/InsForge/pull/2146
* fix(deps): patch Dependabot alerts by @tonychang04 in https://github.com/InsForge/InsForge/pull/2147
* fix(storage): default owner policies on storage.objects for projects created before their first bucket by @v01dstar in https://github.com/InsForge/InsForge/pull/2151
* Bump version to 2.3.5 by @v01dstar in https://github.com/InsForge/InsForge/pull/2154

## New Contributors
* @v01dstar made their first contribution in https://github.com/InsForge/InsForge/pull/2151

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/InsForge/InsForge/compare/v2.3.4...v2.3.5
